purpose: Move the working tree to 0.0.36 because the published 0.0.35 was built at a2af5b4da and contains none of S39-S47. Rebuild the Phase-2 install from the exact 0.0.36 source, re-run the ABI courts, prove the S45 legacy-provider RUNPATH fix survives the rebuild, rebind the downstream atlas identity while carrying every measured row forward explicitly, and regenerate the documentation so the published and unpublished states cannot be confused.

rebuild.target_dir_note: build_phase2.sh hardwires CRATE=/work/target/release/libopenssl_rs.a (and the rlib/extern paths), so CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/target was used. /work/target is the host bind-mounted NVMe tree, not the court overlay and not tmpfs; using /work/court/target would have linked the stale pre-bump archive. TMPDIR stayed on /work/court/tmp. Host MemAvailable was 84 GB before the build.
rebuild.environment_deviation: The subphase brief said to use CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/court/target. That target dir cannot be used for build_phase2.sh without linking a stale archive, because the script does not consult CARGO_TARGET_DIR for CRATE. This is recorded, not hidden.
